falsifiable_hypothesis: A fitting-only, response-free 50%-shrunk within-drug correlation Mahalanobis geometry will improve the bandwidth-0.7 additive residual kernel while preserving the exact 64-well acquisition and all evaluation semantics.

task_contract.ab_rule: average losses across the two separately costed 64-well orientations; never average predictions

method_summary: Within every fitting partition, keep the exact R13 acquisition, own-drug ridge base and global bandwidth-0.7 additive residual kernel structure. For each 2/3-coordinate drug group, estimate a weighted fitting-only correlation matrix from the standardized paid inputs, shrink it 50% toward identity, invert it, and rescale the precision to trace equal to the group dimension. Replace only that group's Euclidean squared distance inside the Gaussian kernel by the resulting Mahalanobis distance. Target responses do not enter the geometry. The residual spectral menu, whole-patient nesting, 64-well budget, A/B loss rule and promotion gate remain unchanged.
